parsed.summary: Tracing the power tree (XT60 -> 10 mOhm shunt R66 -> INA219 -> MIC26903 buck -> LD39200 LDO), the MCU support circuitry (HSE crystals, NRST/bootmode switches, decoupling, VDDA filters), the I2C/SPI peripheral buses and the FCC<->NAVC interconnects, every rail, bus and passive value is internally consistent and matches the specification. The PCA9685 being strapped to 0x41 (A0 high) rather than the 0x40 in the spec table is required to avoid a hard address clash with the INA219 (0x40) on the same NET0095/NET0125 bus, so it is a spec-table inconsistency, not a board deviation; the barometer RESET/EOC swap is a documented known bug. No deviation that would alter intended behaviour is supported by the drawing.
